findings.fix: Do not import business from persistence (it may import: no other layer). Declare an interface for what you need in persistence, implement it in business, and inject the implementation from the composi

findings.reason: presentation may not import persistence: closed layering allows only business>persistence, presentation>business
findings.fix: Go through business: call a business service that wraps what you need from persistence, or move that type into business. presentation may import: business.
